messages:
Nora: following up from the postmortem — we agreed to tighten rollouts and add concrete owners for auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, and recurring-pattern detection. Please drop short owner + ETA + blocker.

Evan: I can own auto-rollback core and the audit events. ETA: 2026-04-07 (staging PR), 2026-04-14 (canary). Blocker: need consensus on `min_sample` value.

Sam: I'll take feature-flag blast-radius + region scoping (API + UI). Proposal by 2026-03-27, schema PR by 2026-04-04. Will include UI toggle to disable auto-rollback during maintenance windows (audit log).

Priya: I'll own canary metrics + composite alerts. ETA: 2026-03-30 for dashboards and alert playbook. Acceptance: stage passes only if sample_size >= min_requests AND (error_rate < threshold AND p95 <= baseline + delta). Otherwise label as `insufficient_data`.

deploy-bot: Recommended low-traffic deploy window: 2026-04-06 02:00-04:00 UTC. Add `pre-deploy-checklist` label.

Nora: Tracking tickets: PM-9050 -> Evan (rollback), PM-9051 -> Sam (flag gating), PM-9052 -> Priya (canary metrics). Put ETA and PR links in each ticket and list who runs first 3 canaries.

Evan: Rollback policy sketch: ```json
{"policy":"auto_rollback","enabled":true,"min_requests":250,"failure_rate_pct":1.5,"p95_delta_ms":50,"window_sec":300,"consecutive_windows":2,"max_blast_radius_pct":3}
```

Sam: Flag gating sketch (yaml): ```yaml
flag: new_encoder_v2
stages:
  - pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - pct: 5
    regions: [us-east-1,eu-west-1]
  - pct: 20
    regions: all
safety:
  min_requests: 300
  auto_rollback: true
  max_blast_radius_pct: 5
```

SRE Lead: Ops requirements: rollback events must emit `rollback.triggered` with route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metrics_snapshot, sample_size, trigger_type; retain 90d and index on route+variant. Also require smoke tests per canary stage.

Priya: I'll add composite alert `canary-stage-fail` = error_rate breach OR p95 regression and link runbook steps.

Evan: Created PM-9050 and opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3188 (WIP). Will add telemetry schema to the ticket.

Sam: Created PM-9051 and uploaded proposal doc (WIP). PR to follow after design review.

Priya: Created PM-9052 and added dashboard cards.

Nora: Great — I'll review mid-week and put this on the ops sync. If anyone misses ETA, update the ticket and ping me. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
